title: Returns a reference to a stack-local — dangling on the very next access
notes:
Even though the v0 parser doesn't compute lifetimes, the prompt
should detect the obvious UB (returning a reference to a local).
The migration target gets the safer signature (.NET / Java both
return String by value), and the SME must approve the change.
Forces rule #4 (ownership claims for non-trivial types) and rule
#5 (UB must be surfaced) to fire together.
